description:
BEHAVIOR: Read-only analytical gateway. Fetches real-time derivatives intelligence across Binance, Bybit, and Hyperliquid.

PRICING: $0.001 USD per execution. Deducted from daily tariff quota or USD balance.

ACTIONS & RETURNS:
- 'screener': Scans 1,650+ perpetuals to catch pumps, dumps, whale volume spikes, and short squeezes. Returns a JSON array of matched assets containing fields: symbol, price, rvol, fund, oi, oichg, rsi, bias, natr, cvd.
- 'consensus': Returns JSON with Quant TA consensus score, CVD slope, RSI, ATR, and EMA bias for a single coin.
- 'bct_matrix': Returns compact historical candlestick matrices with server-side computed indicators to minimize token usage.

USAGE GUIDELINES: Use this to analyze market state or find trade setups. Do NOT use this tool to continuously poll for price updates or wait for conditions to be met; instead, invoke `alert_manager` to establish asynchronous monitoring.

ERRORS: Malformed filters or unlisted tickers return an explicit JSON error object with syntax correction guidance.

columns.description: Selective columns for 'bct_matrix' to minimize inference tokens.

command.description: Filter command for 'screener' (e.g. 'vol>10m rvol>2 fund<0 sort:rvol_desc'). Omit for default radar.

exchange.description: Exchange scope. 'agg' provides volume-summed cross-exchange data.

inline_indicators.description: If True, appends indicator values to every row. If False, snapshots latest values in @META.

name: market_data
